title: Franchisee reconciles cash in 94% less time with ChatGPT Work
summary: An independent Schlotzsky’s and Cinnabon franchisee cut menu repricing time by 95% and built a workflow that could free up $100K in cash flow.
reason: Customer case study on how a franchisee uses ChatGPT Work; no new model, version, or capability release (R1), no research artifact (R2), no financing/M&A/partnership or product launch (R3), no policy action (R4), no OSS tooling (R5).
